880-5702-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-5702-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1445-4871-8250-8347.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-8250-8347.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3967-7084-8338.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

751-3480-3755.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

618-1916-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
618-1916-8227.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Changeling Titan.
When the Changeling Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the Changeling Titan token.
When the Changeling Titan token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Repeat.

3899-4871-5220-7806.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
3899-4871-5220-7806.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

3899-4681-5170-6794.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

821-978-6972.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Repeat.

141-5147-7446.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5147-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-5147-7446.notes: You can choose as many modes as allowed with Moment of Reckoning. You must choose the second mode once, but the other three can be as desired.

4559-5330-7306-7430.notablePrerequisites:
Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
You've had two creatures die under your control this turn.
4559-5330-7306-7430.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gorma.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Gorma and The Ooze trigger.
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve Gorma's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4200-4681-6798.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-4002-4331-4993.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
392-4002-4331-4993.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Manifold Key enters.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3007-3899-3921-4552.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
539-3007-3899-3921-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Toymaker
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

862-4053-5147-6989.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

372-3227-3378.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3227-3378.description:
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Scrivener and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Scrivener trigger.
Resolve the Scrivener trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Scrivener and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2034-3000-5220-5477-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-3000-5220-5477-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating two creature tokens and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

339-677-2292-3499.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3767-3918-4131-5396.description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Basalt Monolith's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

790-2384-6254-6833.description:
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and each opponent to draw cards equal to the greatest number of cards discarded this way, and you to draw twice that number due to Vnwxt.
Psychosis Crawler triggers for each card you draw, and Scrawling Crawler triggers for each card opponents draw.
Resolve the Psychosis Crawler triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life for each card you drew.
Resolve the Scrawling Crawler triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life for each card they drew.
790-2384-6254-6833.notes: The end result is that each opponent will lose life equal to three times the largest amount of cards a player has in their hand. It is recommended to play this combo when it will be lethal for opponents, as it will give them some card draw in additional to the lifeloss.

3875-5413-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
3875-5413-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner trigger that many times.
Resolve all Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating at least two Treasure tokens, and then an additional Clue or Treasure token for each remaining trigger.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

647-3259-6438.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-6438.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Elsha, triggering Breath of Fury and Elsha.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

643-4304-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Maskwood Nexus, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Maskwood Nexus, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

2350-2866-4970-5751--49.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding an artifact land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to draw a card.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning an artifact land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3967-5776-5777.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3967-5776-5777.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing any other creature.
Because the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Camellia and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Camellia trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1020-3689-4659-5121.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding {C}{C}.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Urtet's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing Myr Retriever and the Myr token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {3}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may forego sacrificing the Myr tokens.

2080-4050-4863.notablePrerequisites: The number of nontoken creatures you control plus the number of creature cards in all graveyards is at least nine.
2080-4050-4863.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Revolutionist, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1 for each other nontoken creature you control.
Cast Rise of the Dark Realms by paying {7}{B}{B}, returning all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rise of the Dark Realms to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2-2034-4772-5043.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Alela triggers, creating two 1/1 Faerie creature tokens.
Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two Faeries, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1467-2047-4840.notablePrerequisites: You have not copied a spell using Jin-Gitaxias this turn.
1467-2047-4840.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, copying Myr Battlesphere.
Both Myr Battlespheres enter the battlefield, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a copy of the artifact it is attached to and causing you to win the game.

1308-1558-2740-4231.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Tamiyo's Journal triggers, creating two Food, two Clue, and two Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
